notes.title: Update 1.3 - Test Dummy Takedown
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, crash testers![/b][/h1]

Version 1.3 is finally here with tons of improvements and new features to make your battles even more epic!

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
Various bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.

Improved multiplayer stability.

[h2][b]Interface Overhaul[/b][/h2]
All menus have been completely redesigned for a more modern and intuitive look.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/9775d977da7820c82a94cf03676ee724bc95911d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/c5dd34af872604389be8c2223801f60ab07390fd.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/a152d577ab93d20bb855ea80171df8183e80647b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/63a79a0eaab416a3a7da8254c04a430d106f4358.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8649f8d16d10365e2c07f7e414de000e99341ac1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/0e757d90faf814d12d4a235b227c5ecf8ef7a279.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/b06780bc8fd6bdad59570d3386808a4d66144076.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1faa500f316b82608f3318d4bc0e1401ca8856ab.png[/img][/url]

Easier navigation to quickly access all options.

[h2][b]New Multiplayer Features[/b][/h2]
Steam Friend Invites: Easily invite your friends directly through Steam.

Friends Only Servers: Create private matches and battle only with your friends.




Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep sharing your thoughts so we can make Test Dummy Takedown even more fun and intense!

[b]See you on the battlefield!
The Test Dummy Takedown Team[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to the Test Dummy Takedown Demo V1.0 – Get Ready for Chaos!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to the demo of Test Dummy Takedown. Here’s what’s included[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/5d04ead429d17700cc22f24a4ae5a8bc9eb5c593.png[/img]

[u][h2][b]Multiplayer Mayhem[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]2 to 8 players[/b] battle it out in arenas full of surprises.
Outsmart, outgun, and outlast your opponents to claim victory.


[u][h2][b]Demo Maps[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]Test your skills across three unique arenas:[/b]

Crash Factory – An industrial lab where dummies are put to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4f64473c6c0569ce34f6e219b71dc54fa8911409.png[/img]

Gambling Ground – A chaotic casino where luck rules all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/92e58564675777358add52d8c84e564cd9edbf12.png[/img]

Coconut Chaos – A tropical beach where danger lurks beneath the sand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e6f8873a0ff6c37c26de64bcd8e9fcfb6f8dcb59.png[/img]

[u][h2][b]Weapons & Lives[/b][/h2][/u]

Start each match with a pistol loaded with 30 bullets.

[b]Choose the number of lives (from 1 to 10) to customize the intensity of the fight.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/2712b9197a782b51c8e58e4213c56701d331ca65.png[/img]

[u][h2][b]Power Customization[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]Pick 3 out of 15 special powers to suit your playstyle. Powers are divided into three categories:[/b]

[b]Movement :[/b] Dash, Mega Jump, Super Speed, Spin, Fake Death.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8cf3f35d7cfe23d94fcc81cf74a5a2afc9985205.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4bc08d4e0c736fbb9d9b3db97ce71242f4834eae.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/2c369dd84c278de47f352d3d0ade6286a2d34722.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4cdf3ff23f90dc449fa167598b13df26323f02a2.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/813d37cf7acf501d26f7d405384e2437be661fb7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e59662576f86f6c56e7ee65af208acf79acf4f3d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/53d95744f7967dee571734c9a18b44ded40be289.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/d3dc0bdb24d276c61029315f7ae0298de7684c94.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1c4621cea8eabd2e425a8fd1f49ea9fa1ced8939.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ce6bf86e76d51e9f3132eca8d72bf32a51b6b01f.png[/img][/url]

[b]Ability :[/b] Dummy Boom, Invisibility, Invincibility, Heal, Fast Reload.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/a820d175531a98f0440ae07232a2b21a35c10a86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/48b41de6842634920ce7334931dd1ab352be97ee.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/6090b5aa035d7d0e979a03895e4e2fb4cdf79a0e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/da2d59fd2dc3376718a11ec98a7c12f65657f382.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/d88f2e82703d235cb2f37d01fbb784eae5cc8f2f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/10dcc31c245f6a247796094b1ea77dedd6eb1699.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/b25525e72aae2db3c8bfbe34fd25baeb8f97ded8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/25103c270d4e864acb482fbe31e8098777365215.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/9880f905291df0430f7ac54954c4826647ba4c53.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/219ca5f76fd30d1d0e5bfc03b726f256ab26dc71.png[/img][/url]

[b]Secondary Weapon :[/b] Grenade, Sniper, Knife Throw, Knife Strike, Golden Gun.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1c0df8ed38b108c144adfd3d4cc3495288efb396.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/770a7f421738014c8dcbb55d6f1f80bbdd3a7ed3.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/625c79842bc8732b1f7d5d012056e19c585a81fd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/6f914d4d5d22a8a25dcd3f6aef5bb5e0c7e4aeb9.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1da2232e4698efe32f2770b9987e7da3a99704c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/802dc9f0cd597866709c9ba34de61bc29a2a62eb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/db77a659c129f61e5d6421082acfeeacaa5cb25f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/35d9ed9db0e60db32f3478979f141011140149ee.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4c0e9ac8e2b30ca77777047f351095321a4bcdaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/d0812062cae46c690e32a1f5895fa7c8026f73aa.png[/img][/url]

[u][h2][b]Dummy Customization[/b][/h2][/u]

Stand out on the battlefield with a selection of accessories to personalize your dummy.

[b]Choose from 10 accessories for your dummy, with more to come![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/64a5f763017cc817ac4d9d8419a5bd905f73bb1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/f3451b62f8f3f1c62aa71efbb6760438437416c4.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/9604f00aa8836ea87b1b72c303f282a1067fb105.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/cdf000b0e167e96d30c4132ee7ced5d8586ddc3c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4feac243bbf33d718143900aacd64aa7c9a688aa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/bcd4095dfddff434bb9ca0af50f5a19d6afa0506.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/7901a8563d2f654ef60c68c5fd946a1bd97b4e03.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ab1ed52efe7f935633d43b6b9e3f1a90f3f32296.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/10a656cb3a0fa5db4e1e16939a383afddb7d02a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/f6a383ad932c34295cb71e1768f78b0e099367f8.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/6225ba33091a04eb3a6e86f0c4c415505aa2dd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/70f9b34460b5ecc9048f8dd5aa093763d8bc7a3b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/7de94737cb43c6bb61afb0d26648956fc7bd37dc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8a7e55ce8bcb5094214facce7d822d29f18906d6.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ed5712da3f85723af41cfa287426ae14519a288d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/e5412d1cad25e5a29bf10df47a2259806569bde0.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/1f2e38abe6eb220046cb3ca84e5cc1b1f3b60925.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8dad52dcc1fc293937203b3270187000604e5466.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8bf19b6f0bde6cbfd6208c2d077d624afc4e1cd7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/0eaa29eda3996dfec6c2bf9c783f7f360fe883af.png[/img][/url]

[b]Choose the color of your dummy![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/370e56ae8b7bf67fbc3df26a6e3c07dd7c50b4a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/507ae1eee7033a2463ec58b24fecf14f8cd980e5.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/f42c87885711b4ecdde9be5fc459913f3f8c3467.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/8e64e776586e8ef67b0e9b2ed07d6480c3feafd3.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/942213c6808eb3e736cc28e999e06661192ab4ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/ab7124032c533f5ac05bea1f2d6fefb28213c1d2.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/4ec83a0f31e3cb3f461811a029181e79d04df11b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/5a7e7968b8e5aa1e3ea789dfb7d60e00bf755b28.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/21463e2df8d334eb99810736ffbd6e32145d75c9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170960/204d7d171b7d4fc5872c1b6e6326da35576c4084.png[/img][/url]

[u][h2][b]Strategy & Survival[/b][/h2][/u]

Manage your three powers wisely—use them at the right moment or remove them to save them for later.
The last dummy standing wins. Use every tool at your disposal to take down your opponents.


[u][h2][b]The Ultimate Party Battle[/b][/h2][/u]

[b]Test Dummy Takedown[/b] is the perfect game for chaotic, fun-filled nights with friends. Every match is different, filled with unpredictable moments and crazy plays.

[b]Are you ready to take on the challenge? Jump in and let the chaos begin.[/b]
